title: Gastrodin Attenuates Colitis and Prevents Tumorigenesis in Mice by Interrupting TLR4/MD2/NF-kappaB Signaling Transduction.
authors: Yu, Zhilun; Yue, Bei; Gao, Ruiyang; Zhang, Beibei; Geng, Xiaolong; Lv, Cheng; Wang, Hao; Wang, Ziyi; Wang, Zhengtao; Dou, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天麻素通过分子对接与CETSA验证其与MD2蛋白结合并抑制TLR4/NF-κB信号通路，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但核心是炎症与肿瘤发生，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法用于核酸互作建模。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Chronic inflammation is one of the causative factors for tumorigenesis. Gastrodin is a main active ingredient isolated from Gastrodia elata Blume, a famous medicinal herb with a long edible history. AIM: This study aimed to explore the effects of gastrodin on colitis-associated carcinogenesis (CRC) in mice and to elucidate its potential molecular mechanisms. METHODS: Balb/c mice were induced with azoxymethane (AOM) and dextran sulfate sodium (DSS) for 12 weeks. Gastrodin (50 mg/kg) was administered via oral gavage three times per week until the end of the experiment. Disease indexes, including body weight, bloody diarrhea, colon length, histopathological score, and tumor size, were measured. Tumor cell proliferation was evaluated by BrdU incorporation assay and tumor cell cytotoxicity was assessed by cell counting kit (CCK-8). The expression levels of toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4)/nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB) signaling molecules, NF-kappaB luciferase, and pro-inflammatory cytokines were determined by real-time fluorescence quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR), immunoblotting, immunohistochemistry (IHC), enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), or reporter gene assays. The binding affinity between gastrodin and myeloid differentiation protein-2 (MD2) was analyzed by molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA). RESULTS: Gastrodin administration was demonstrated to mitigate various CRC-related symptoms in mice, including weight loss, diarrhea, and tissue abnormalities. Notably, gastrodin suppressed tumor cell growth during colitis- associated tumorigenesis, resulting in fewer and smaller adenomas in the colon. Unlike irinotecan, a broadspectrum antitumor drug, gastrodin did not exhibit apparent cytotoxicity in various colorectal adenocarcinoma cell lines. Additionally, gastrodin downregulated TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling molecules and pro-inflammatory mediators in mice and macrophages. Molecular docking and CETSA experiments suggested that gastrodin binds to the MD2 protein, potentially interfering with the recognition of lipopolysaccharide (LPS) by TLR4, leading to NF-kappaB pathway inhibition. CONCLUSION: This study provides evidence for the first time that gastrodin attenuated colitis and prevented colitisrelated carcinogenesis in mice, at least partially, by diminishing tumor-promoting cytokines through the interruption of TLR4/MD2/NF-kappaB signaling transduction.
abstract_zh: 引言：慢性炎症是肿瘤发生的致病因素之一。天麻素（Gastrodin）是从天麻（Gastrodia elata Blume）中分离出的主要活性成分，天麻是一种具有悠久食用历史的著名药材。目的：本研究旨在探讨天麻素对小鼠结肠炎相关癌变（CRC）的影响，并阐明其潜在分子机制。方法：Balb/c小鼠经氧化偶氮甲烷（AOM）和葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导12周。天麻素（50 mg/kg）通过口服灌胃给药，每周三次，直至实验结束。测量疾病指标，包括体重、血性腹泻、结肠长度、组织病理学评分和肿瘤大小。通过BrdU掺入实验评估肿瘤细胞增殖，并通过细胞计数试剂盒（CCK-8）评估肿瘤细胞毒性。通过实时荧光定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）、免疫印迹、免疫组织化学（IHC）、酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）或报告基因实验测定toll样受体4（TLR4）/核因子kappa-B（NF-kappaB）信号分子、NF-kappaB荧光素酶和促炎细胞因子的表达水平。通过分子对接和细胞热位移实验（CETSA）分析天麻素与髓样分化蛋白-2（MD2）之间的结合亲和力。结果：天麻素给药被证明可缓解小鼠多种CRC相关症状，包括体重减轻、腹泻和组织异常。值得注意的是，天麻素在结肠炎相关肿瘤发生过程中抑制肿瘤细胞生长，导致结肠中腺瘤数量减少且体积变小。与广谱抗肿瘤药物伊立替康（irinotecan）不同，天麻素在多种结直肠腺癌细胞系中未表现出明显细胞毒性。此外，天麻素下调小鼠和巨噬细胞中TLR4/NF-kappaB信号分子和促炎介质。分子对接和CETSA实验提示，天麻素与MD2蛋白结合，可能干扰TLR4对脂多糖（LPS）的识别，导致NF-kappaB通路抑制。结论：本研究首次提供证据表明，天麻素通过中断TLR4/MD2/NF-kappaB信号转导，至少部分通过减少促肿瘤细胞因子，减轻小鼠结肠炎并预防结肠炎相关癌变。
